title: Кібератака групи UAC-0057 (unc1151) на державні організації України з  використанням шкідливої програми MicroBackdoor (CERT-UA#4109)

entities.name: UAC-0057
entities.gloss: A cyberespionage threat group also tracked as UNC1151, associated with attacks against Ukraine.

entities.name: Mandiant
entities.gloss: An American cybersecurity firm providing threat intelligence and incident response services.

entities.name: MicroBackdoor
entities.gloss: An open-source C++ backdoor malware providing remote command execution and basic bot management capabilities.

entities.name: довідка.zip
entities.gloss: A ZIP archive used as an initial infection vector containing a malicious CHM file.

entities.name: dovidka.chm
entities.gloss: A Microsoft Compiled HTML Help file used to drop decoy content and execute malicious script files.

entities.name: image.jpg
entities.gloss: A decoy image file containing instructions on actions during artillery shelling.

entities.name: file.htm
entities.gloss: An HTA file containing malicious VBScript code embedded within a CHM file.

entities.name: ignit.vbs
entities.gloss: A VBScript dropper responsible for decoding and dropping the .NET loader and supporting components.

entities.name: core.dll
entities.gloss: A .NET loader DLL that decodes and executes the MicroBackdoor payload.

entities.name: desktop.ini
entities.gloss: A malicious script file used to execute the core.dll loader via regasm.exe.

entities.name: Windows Prefetch.lNk
entities.gloss: A malicious Windows shortcut file placed in Startup to execute desktop.ini using wscript.exe.

entities.name: microbackdoor.dll
entities.gloss: A dynamic link library payload implementing the MicroBackdoor functionality.

entities.name: xbeta[.]online
entities.gloss: A domain name configured and used as a command and control server for MicroBackdoor.
An IP address associated with command and control infrastructure in the attack.

entities.name: cr4sh
entities.gloss: The developer alias of Dmytro Oleksiuk, original author of the MicroBackdoor tool.

relations.head: UAC-0057
relations.evidence: Активність асоційовано з діяльністю групи UAC-0057

relations.head: довідка.zip
relations.evidence: довідка.zip", який містить файл контекстної довідки (Microsoft Compiled HTML Help) "dovidka.chm"

relations.head: dovidka.chm
relations.evidence: CHM-файл, у свою чергу, містить зображення-приманку "image.jpg" ... та HTA-файл "file.htm"

relations.head: dovidka.chm
relations.evidence: CHM-файл, у свою чергу, містить зображення-приманку "image.jpg"

relations.head: file.htm
relations.evidence: призведе до створення на комп'ютері і запуску дропера "ignit.vbs"

relations.head: core.dll
relations.evidence: .NET-лоадер здійснить декодування і виконання шкідливої програми MicroBackdoor
